Petition of Western Massachusetts Electric Company d/b/a Eversource Energy for an order by the Department of Public Utilities authorizing the Company to defer, for future recovery in rates, the costs incurred in relation to a change in the valuation basis of municipal property tax in the City of Springfield for the calendar year 2016.
